messages:
raj_support: Hey team — multiple customers hitting 5xx from hosted inference starting ~10:20 UTC. Examples show upstream 503/502 from our API gateway when calling /v1/generate. Request IDs: rQf7-84, aK2d-91. Any visibility on control-plane deps?

maria_oncall: Thanks, raj. I'm seeing an alert for control-plane auth-service p95 latency rising and a config DB connection-pool exhaustion alert. Can you drop a sample error payload? I'll page infra. :rotating_light:

raj_support: Paste from customer log: `{"status":503,"error":"upstream_error","detail":"authz failed: timeout after 1000ms"}`. Also a couple traces show `503 gateway response — routing-policy returned 500`.

emma_sre: Triage notes: authz is returning 500s and timing out. On the control-plane dashboard I see a burst of DB connection wait time and routing-policy service CPU spike at ~10:18. Looks like simultaneous load spike + configdb latency.

ops-bot: [alert] svc-routing-policy: p99 latency 3.2s (↑), config-db pool usage 98% (threshold 85%). Incident link: https://mon/INC-4821

luke_eng: Did we push a routing policy change or deploy recently? I can check deploys.

emma_sre: There was a canary of routing-policy at 10:15 with a lambda-style change to add new selectors. Canary traffic was small but looks like it triggered higher DB fanout in some tenant paths.

chris_infra: I'm bumping config DB read pool size temporarily and increasing max connections on the configdb replicas. Doing `psql -c "alter system set max_connections = '500'"` on read replica group-2, will roll in 30s.

raj_support: Customer workaround suggestion sent: retry with exponential backoff; we'll keep them posted. One customer reported a correlated spike in embedding-only routes.

emma_sre: Quick mitigation plan: 1) increase configdb pool and backpressure routing-policy (set concurrency throttle to smaller value), 2) rollback canary if we confirm change correlated, 3) fail open auth path for non-sensitive tenants to reduce auth calls (temporary). I'll open an action PR for throttle.

luke_eng: Confirmed routing-policy canary introduced additional per-request lookups to configdb. Rolling canary back now: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/routing-policy -n controlplane --to-revision=42`.

ops-bot: [deploy] rollback started for routing-policy by luke_eng at 10:29 UTC

chris_infra: DB pool increase live. Observability shows connection wait time dropping.

maria_oncall: Noted. Setting incident update: "We observed elevated config DB latency that caused auth and routing-policy to return 5xx; rollback and infra scaling in progress; mitigation applied. Next update in 15m." :thumbsup:

raj_support: Thanks. I'll reply to affected customers with ETA. Any postmortem blockers?

emma_sre: Collecting traces and sample spans for the tenants impacted. We'll include the canary change and DB pool metrics in the postmortem. For now, add action item: add circuit-breaker and local cache for routing-policy to avoid fanout.

luke_eng: Agreed. Also adding a smoke test to the canary pipeline to hit configdb-heavy codepaths before wider rollout.

chris_infra: Monitoring now shows error rate trending back to baseline. I'll keep scaling knobs available if we see another spike.

maria_oncall: Closing oncall handoff: watch for any regression, escalate to SE if customers report persistent 5xx. Next update at 10:45 UTC.

raj_support: Appreciate the fast response. Will follow up once customers confirm green. :white_check_mark:
